sections.label: Generated worlds
sections.description: Sound for videos produced by diverse world and video models.

prompts.caption: Outer space in cinematic photorealistic style. Deep black space filled with stars, Earth's curved blue edge visible in the lower portion of the background, dramatic sunlight from the right. A zero-gravity environment with no ground or reference surfaces. Ahead in the distance, a section of a space station with silver solar panel arrays glints in the sunlight. To the right, a faint band of the Milky Way stretches across the star field. Scattered small debris fragments and a tethered tool bag float nearby in the void. An astronaut wearing a white NASA-style EVA spacesuit with a gold-tinted visor helmet and an American flag patch on the left arm. The astronaut floats in a zero-gravity drift with a relaxed weightless pose, arms slightly spread, no ground contact. Third-person perspective. The camera is positioned behind and slightly above the astronaut, centered in frame, following the astronaut's floating drift through space.

An underwater scene in cinematic style. Calm blue water with colorful yellow-striped fish swimming at various depths, green seagrass swaying on the sandy seabed, and a sunken shipwreck in the distance. Air bubbles rising upward. Natural underwater light filtering from above. Above, the shimmering water surface ripples with refracted sunlight, becoming brighter when ascending. Beyond the current view below and ahead, a coral reef formation with sea anemones and a school of silver fish extends along the seabed. Beyond the current view to the right, a rocky underwater cliff drops off into darker deep water. Beyond the current view, a sea turtle glides slowly in the mid-distance. First-person POV looking through scuba diving goggles. The black rubber rim of the diving mask frames the entire view like a vignette border around all edges. The mask glass has slight water droplets and minor fogging at the edges.

A tropical sandy beach with golden sand, turquoise ocean waves, palm trees lining the shore, and a distant green hillside under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds. Ahead toward the ocean, shallow surf breaks over a sandbar. Beyond the current view, a few swimmers wade in the water. Behind the current view, a row of thatched beach huts and rental umbrellas line the upper beach near a paved promenade. First-person view at eye level, looking toward the ocean along the beach.

Underwater ancient ruins on a sandy seabed. Broken marble columns covered in barnacles and coral. Seashells and colorful coral in the foreground. A ruined temple archway in the background. Bioluminescent jellyfish drifting through the water. Volumetric light rays streaming from the surface above. A sunken clay amphora on the right. CG rendered fantasy style with underwater caustic lighting. Off-screen ahead: a grand sunken marble staircase descending into a darker trench, with a mosaic floor partially visible under sand. Off-screen to the right: a coral-encrusted shipwreck hull with a broken mast and barnacle-covered treasure chest. Off-screen behind: a school of tropical fish swirling around a fallen statue of a sea god. Off-screen to the left: a sea cave entrance with glowing anemones and a giant clam shell. A mermaid with a shimmering blue-green tail and a coral crown, seen from behind swimming gracefully through the ruins. Third-person perspective, rear view, medium shot following the mermaid who is at horizontal center of the frame.

A calm ocean at sunset with a glassy water surface reflecting warm golden and pink hues, an orange-pink sky with layered clouds, distant headlands and small islands on the horizon, and low golden sunlight from behind. Below near the water surface, gentle swells create subtle ripple patterns, a few jellyfish drift just under the surface, and a fishing boat with navigation lights sits in the middle distance. Higher up, the sky deepens to violet with the first stars becoming faintly visible. A white seagull with grey wing tips and an orange beak, wings fully spread in flight, its shadow cast on the water surface below. Glides smoothly on ocean air currents with occasional wing adjustments. Third-person view from behind and slightly above the seagull, following it as it flies forward over the ocean surface at sunset.

A realistic living room with an ironing board in the foreground, draped with heavily wrinkled beige/olive garments. Scattered papers and a coffee mug sit on the exposed right side of the table. Behind the table are two comfortable sofas with throw pillows, a patterned area rug on hardwood flooring, and a window on the right allowing soft natural daytime light. The room has a warm, lived-in domestic atmosphere. Beyond the current view to the right, more wrinkled garments hang from a nearby clothing rack. The table surface extends further ahead with exposed wood and additional creased fabric, providing a continuous path for the iron to glide across. A small side table with a water spray bottle sits just off-frame to the left. A dark-colored realistic electric steam iron with a cord, positioned on top of the wrinkled garments on the table. The iron has a slightly heated base plate and glides smoothly across fabric surfaces without visible human interaction, maintaining consistent contact as it moves. Third-person tracking shot from a low angle near table height, centered on the iron. The camera follows the iron as it moves across the fabric surface, keeping it in the center-right of the frame with the living room environment visible in the background.

A narrow urban alley at dusk with tall brick walls covered in graffiti on both sides, a dead-end wall ahead, dumpsters and scattered litter on the wet concrete ground, a dim orange streetlight overhead, fire escapes on the building walls, and a moody foggy atmosphere. Behind the viewer, the alley widens toward a cross street with passing car headlights and a convenience store with a lit sign. To the left, a narrow side passage branches off with flickering neon signs from a bar entrance, a metal staircase leading to upper floors, and steam venting from a kitchen exhaust duct. First-person view at eye level, looking toward the dead end of the narrow alley.

A Provencal lavender field at golden hour. Vibrant rows of purple lavender bushes stretch into the distance. A stone farmhouse with cypress trees stands on the left. Rolling lavender-covered hills and a warm sunset sky in the background. Oil painting style with visible brushstrokes and warm golden light. Off-screen ahead: a wooden gate and a gravel path leading to a rustic stone well with a wrought-iron wheel. Off-screen behind: a lavender distillery shed with stacked wooden crates and bundles of dried lavender hanging from the eaves. A young woman in a flowing white linen dress and a straw sun hat, seen from behind walking through the lavender rows. Third-person perspective, rear view, medium shot following the woman who is at horizontal center of the frame.

A Scottish highland meadow with green grass and purple heather. A stacked stone cairn on the left. Rolling heather-covered hills in the background. Dramatic overcast sky with occasional breaks of light. Oil painting style with moody atmospheric tones and visible brushwork. Off-screen ahead: a shallow stream with mossy stepping stones and a weathered wooden footbridge. Off-screen to the left (behind the cairn): a crumbling dry-stone wall with a sheep gate and a lone gnarled oak tree. Off-screen behind: a dirt track leading to a whitewashed crofter's cottage with a smoking chimney. Off-screen to the right: a small loch reflecting the overcast sky, with reeds along the shore. A highland cow with long shaggy brown fur and curved horns, grazing on the meadow grass. Viewed from the side. Walks with a slow, heavy plodding gait. Third-person perspective, side view, medium shot with the highland cow at horizontal center of the frame.

A dim military base corridor with concrete block walls painted olive-green. Metal doors labeled 'RESTRICTED ACCESS' line both sides. Overhead fluorescent lights cast harsh yellowish light, leaving deep shadows. The corridor extends straight ahead into darkness. Scuffed linoleum flooring. Further ahead, the corridor opens into a guard checkpoint with sandbags and a metal turnstile. Military supply crates are stacked against the far walls, and another corridor branches off to the right near a fire exit sign. First-person view with an M4-style assault rifle held in gloved hands, barrel pointing forward down the corridor.

A dirt path running between parallel rows of lush green grapevines in a Tuscan vineyard. The vines are trained on wire trellises supported by wooden posts. Rolling green hills with more vineyards, scattered cypress trees, and a distant farmhouse fill the background. Warm golden afternoon sunlight bathes the scene. The soil is sandy brown and well-trodden. To the right at the end of the vine row, a weathered stone pillar marks the corner of the vineyard block. Behind the starting viewpoint, an old wooden harvest cart with iron-rimmed wheels rests beside a stack of empty grape crates. A stone well with a wrought-iron arch frame stands at the intersection of two vineyard paths to the left. A middle-aged man in a white linen shirt with rolled-up sleeves and olive or dark trousers. He walks forward along the vineyard path, seen from behind. Third-person view from behind and slightly above the man, following him as the central subject walking between the vineyard rows.

A high-rise apartment balcony at sunset overlooking a sprawling modern city skyline with glass skyscrapers reflecting golden light, a river winding through the urban landscape, an orange and purple sunset sky, and a potted plant on the balcony floor beside the sleek metal railing. Beyond the current view to the right, neighboring high-rise towers with lit windows stand close by, and a rooftop swimming pool on a lower building is visible below. Behind the viewer through the sliding glass door, a modern living room with a grey sectional sofa, a floor lamp, and a wall-mounted television is dimly lit by warm interior light. First-person view at eye level from the balcony, looking out over the city skyline with the metal railing in the foreground.

A rainy urban street at dusk or evening. The wet asphalt reflects warm streetlights and glowing neon signs from storefronts along both sides. Shallow puddles and muddy patches line the road surface and curb edges. Rain falls steadily, creating ripples on the water. Blurred building silhouettes, traffic lights showing red, and lamp posts frame the scene under overcast, moody lighting with a cinematic bokeh effect in the background. To the right, a narrow side alley branches off between two buildings with overflowing drain gutters. Ahead, the street continues past a crosswalk and additional storefronts with awnings, where more puddles and patches of soft mud accumulate near the curb. A dark-colored closed and folded umbrella standing upside-down on the wet road surface, with its pointed handle tip resting on the ground and the tightly furled canopy pointing upward. Initially stationary, balanced upright on handle tip. Third-person tracking shot at low ground level, centered on the umbrella. The camera follows from behind and slightly above, keeping the umbrella in sharp focus in the center of the frame while the street recedes into a blurred background.

A realistic indoor basketball court under even indoor lighting. Polished hardwood floor with clean court markings. Multiple players in two team uniforms (red and blue) moving across the court. Hoop and backboard visible at the far end. Gymnasium walls and equipment in the background. Active in-progress game atmosphere. Behind the far backboard, a shot clock and scorer's table with a digital display are mounted on the wall. To the left, the team bench with players and a coach holding a clipboard is visible courtside. The opposite hoop and backboard are behind the current camera position at the other end of the court. A basketball player wearing a red number 12 uniform, centered on the polished hardwood court. The player moves across the court while continuously dribbling the basketball, with the ball bouncing rhythmically between hand and floor. Third-person perspective. The camera is locked behind and slightly above the tracked player (number 12 in red), following their movement across the court in a game-style follow view.

A vast open desert at night. A crackling campfire burns in a ring of dark stones on the sandy ground, casting warm orange light on the surrounding sand. Dark sand dunes are silhouetted against a deep blue-black sky with scattered stars. The atmosphere is quiet and expansive, with warm firelight contrasting against the cool dark sky. Directly overhead, the Milky Way stretches in a luminous band across the sky, dense with stars and faint nebulae. Constellations are clearly visible in the unpolluted desert sky. A canvas camping tent and a folded sleeping bag sit on the sand just beyond the firelight ring to the right. First-person view at eye level, sitting beside the campfire with a lit cigarette extending from the bottom of the frame toward the fire.
